decision.justification: Selected 'weighted weighted by w5' (an agent proposal) as the best of 12 backtested attempts, score 0.9217. Series context: trend strength 0.8686 and seasonal strength 0.0405; model ranking is unstable across windows (Kendall tau 0.197); 3 of 19 models carry independent error; relative error spread across the pool is 4.702.
